title: Implement the capability-aware ACP worker adapter
description: Expose a small typed boundary for start, prompt, events, permission/question reply, cancel and optional resume. Represent unavailable capabilities explicitly. Keep worker credentials and process details out of model prompts. Delegate model/tool execution to worker harnesses. Use bounded request timeouts and terminate owned child processes on shutdown.
why: Provider differences should not leak into every assistant feature.

acceptance.text: Cursor and the selected OpenAI worker pass the same adapter contract tests
Unknown blocking requests get a clear failure instead of hanging
Cancellation and process exit close pending requests
Resume is offered only when negotiated and verified

outcome.summary: Completed the shared ACP client and verified both selected providers against the live and isolated contracts.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; six unit contract tests; live Cursor and Codex session/prompt/resume contract; acceptance evidence in ticket comment
